resolution.note: rows record afterSuite/baseSuite; regressed true/false proven by test/evals/replay-regression.test.ts; report regression per arm and C-A existed (#1490)

title: Replay grades regressions: the repo's existing suite runs at the base and after each rep
body:
Source: S8 readiness audit 2026-11-19 (lead session); ADR 0021 points 10-11.
Evidence: evals/units/screening.ts:502-527 runs install and the hidden unit.test only; evals/replay/grade-preflight.ts checks the hidden test on base and reference; no pre-existing suite run, evals/replay computes no regression.
Outcome: each replay row records base-suite and after-suite results for the unit repo's own tests (tests that passed at the base commit), and the row carries regressed: true when a rep passes the hidden tests yet breaks one of them; the report prints regression rate per arm and C−A.
Proof: a replay test on a fixture repo where a rep passes the hidden test and breaks a base-passing test yields regressed: true; one that keeps them green yields false.
